descriptionHtml: In collaboration with IEEE Student Branch of University of Peradeniya, celebrating its 20 years of journey, the Power and Energy Society Student Branch Chapter has organized an online talk event   on the second day of "Splendour"  . The talk event will be led by three distinguished and skilled engineers of private and government  sectors, based on their experiences on how to face a job interview successfully and  also job opportunities in both government and private sectors. The talk event will be extended over two productive hours including a Q & A session at the end.
